title: A Phase III Study to Evaluate the Efficacy and Safety of Petrelintide in Participants with Overweight or Obesity and Established Cardiovascular Disease
official: A Phase III, Randomized, Double-Blind, Placebo Controlled, Parallel Group Study to Evaluate the Efficacy and Safety of Once Weekly Petrelintide Vs. Placebo in Participants with Overweight or Obesity and Established Cardiovascular Disease
summary: Main objective: To evaluate the efficacy of Petrelintide compared with placebo on change in body weight with respect to percent (%) change from baseline in body weight at Week 64
conditions: Overweight or Obesity and Established Cardiovascular Disease
criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
1. BMI ≥ 27.0 kg/m2
2. Age ≥40 years at the time of signing Informed Consent Form
3. Ability and willingness to comply with all aspects of the protocol including completion of all procedures, study visits, questionnaires, assessments for the duration of the study
4. Have a history of at least one self-reported unsuccessful dietary effort to lose body weight
5. Agreement to adhere to the contraception requirements
Exclusion criteria:
1. Current or previous treatment with petrelintide or any other amylin analog
